metadata.description: Claude Code plugins and mods made by anderson-spider.

plugins.name: chatgpt
plugins.description: Lets Claude ask your logged-in ChatGPT, or have it generate an image, through terminal-browser, and saves the result locally.

plugins.name: codex-computer-use
plugins.description: Routes native Mac app control through Codex computer use from the ChatGPT app, with per-app approval, one Codex session per Claude session or subagent, and /codex-cu on|off.

plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: Makes the main session a lead that delegates to five specialist subagents: code-reader and research on Haiku; designer and developer on Sonnet; architect on Opus. The developer runs and reports its tests; the architect independently audits acceptance. With the jevKey option set (a TypeSafe key), Jev sizes only each call's effort, bounded to medium or high; models stay at role defaults or fixed twin ids, and any Jev request or config failure requests medium unless the agent has already sent its first step; that sends a redacted, truncated prompt to api.typesafe.ai. When a local HTTP loopback proxy is ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, each role also gets a fixed-model crew:<role>-codex twin. Calls may be routed automatically to those twins when Codex has more weekly headroom, with or without Jev; what those subagents read and write goes to OpenAI through the proxy.

plugins.name: tailscale
plugins.description: Lets Claude query and modify the tailnet through the Tailscale API, using TS_API_KEY.

plugins.name: codex-models
plugins.description: Offers OpenAI Codex models (ChatGPT login) in Claude Code through a local loopback proxy, in /model and in agent definitions, while Claude models pass through to Anthropic unchanged.
